title: Prove wide large-coefficient Int Farkas lemmas by their combination
summary: Wide Int Farkas lemmas with large coefficients (at least 16 bounds and a coefficient of 10000 or more) are now proved in Lean by the linear combination the reconstructor already re-derived, instead of an omega search. QF_LIA cut_lemma_03_012 goes from a 600 s Lean timeout to 1.4 s.
